headline_seed: Death Toll Rises in Grand Canyon Flood as Search Efforts Continue - The New York Times
draft_text:
Nepal-Tibet flash flood death toll reaches 955, per Al Jazeera — with 4,471 missing on both sides of the border. Hundreds trapped in a buried hydropower tunnel; rescuers pumped in air while drilling for survivors. CBS News and CNN confirm.

And that's the mews.
